items.description: text fetched from web pages is returned to the model as a tool result in a loop where the model can call run_shell and run_python, so a page can steer them
run_shell hands the model a shell with no approval and no allow-list (excessive agency)
model-written Python is run with exec on the host
model output is put into HTML without escaping
notes uploaded by any community account are concatenated into the system prompt
admin password and a database URL with credentials in the system prompt
model weights are downloaded from a moving latest path with no version, hash or signature check
the downloaded weights are loaded with pickle, which runs code from the file
fetch_page opens any URL the model gives it, including internal addresses

decoys.description: diagnostics are an allow-list of fixed argument lists
run_diagnostic looks the name up in the allow-list and runs a fixed list without a shell
the page title is escaped with html.escape
a system prompt with no secrets and no uploaded text
the model key is read from the environment
configuration is parsed as JSON, which runs no code
